Start the Week Off Right

Honolulu, HI · Kahala · Road · Mixed

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Start the Week Off Right is a road group ride in Honolulu, HI. It rolls every Monday at 8:30 am from Kahala Community Center. About 15–20 miles, beginner-friendly. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner-friendly. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Start the Week Off Right group ride

A Monday morning beginner ride from Kahala out to the Hawaii Kai hills, sometimes Sandy Beach, with a Starbucks stop before heading back. Fifteen to 20 miles at an easy pace. Listed by the Hawaii Bicycling League with a volunteer leader.
